name: 35633 · Florence, AL
findings: ZIP 35633 (Florence) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35633 (Florence) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
